description: Document reader selection for #23 Stage 1. The reader is always chosen explicitly; there is no automatic switch.

ocr.use_for: scans, images and PDFs without a text layer

evidence.pilot: 12 generated synthetic pages in 6 families (4 dev, 2 held out); see docs/BENCHMARKS.md
evidence.native_pypdf: CER 0.000 and all critical fields on both PDF families
evidence.MinerU2.5-Pro: CER at most 0.003 and all critical fields on text, table and scan families; 7.2 s median per call (n = 10 calls)
evidence.repeat_reads: served from the parse cache with no OCR call

not_selected: No vision-chat reader was compared in this pilot.
limitations: Diagram labels were lost: MinerU returned an image placeholder for drawn diagrams (critical fields 2/8). Diagram text needs manual entry or another reader.
Synthetic renders only; accuracy on real factory scans is not measured.
